distribution_model.detail: Owns and operates resorts, retail stores, lodging and dining; sells passes, tickets and rentals directly online.

market_position.detail: Self-described luxury destination travel at iconic resorts, plus regional ski areas and value-oriented Epic Pass.

notes: Market position blends luxury destination resorts with lower-priced regional areas and passes; premium chosen as single best fit.

product_category.detail: Ski resort lift access and passes, lessons, lodging, dining, and snow sports gear retail and rental.

purchase_frequency.detail: Seasonal ski trips and vacations, with annual pass purchases before the season.

sub_sector.value: destination ski resorts; snow sports retail and rental; mountain lodging
